info.name: Kinde Account API Keys Search API

params.name: page_size
params.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to 10 if parameter not sent.

params.name: query
params.description: Search the users by email or name. Use '*' to search all.

params.name: api_scopes
params.description: Search the users by api scopes.

params.name: starting_after
params.description: The ID of the user to start after.

params.name: ending_before
params.description: The ID of the user to end before.

params.name: expand
params.description: Additional data to include in the response. One or more of (comma-separated): "organizations", "identities", "properties".

items.docs:
Search for users based on the provided query string. Set query to '*' to filter by other parameters only. The number of records to return at a time can be controlled using the `page_size` query string parameter.
